 import pytest

+from ansible.cli.doc import DocCLI, RoleMixin
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('collection, expected_name', [('', 'example'), ('namespace.collection', 'namespace.collection.example')])
+def test_role_build_doc(collection, expected_name):
+    main_spec = {'short_description': 'Main entry point', 'options': {'value': {'type': 'str'}}}
+    other_spec = {'short_description': 'Other entry point'}
+    argspec = {'main': main_spec, 'other': other_spec}
+
+    fqcn, doc = RoleMixin()._build_doc('example', '/roles/example', collection, argspec)
+
+    assert fqcn == expected_name
+    assert doc == {'path': '/roles/example', 'collection': collection, 'entry_points': argspec}
+    assert doc['entry_points']['main'] is main_spec
+    assert doc['entry_points']['other'] is other_spec
+
+    filtered_name, filtered_doc = RoleMixin()._build_doc('example', '/roles/example', collection, argspec, 'other')
+    assert filtered_name == expected_name
+    assert filtered_doc['entry_points'] == {'other': other_spec}
+    assert filtered_doc['entry_points']['other'] is other_spec
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('argspec, entry_point', [({}, None), ({'main': {'options': {}}}, 'missing')])
+def test_role_build_doc_without_matching_entry_points(argspec, entry_point):
+    assert RoleMixin()._build_doc('example', '/roles/example', None, argspec, entry_point) == ('example', None)
+
+
+def test_role_build_doc_preserves_empty_spec():
+    empty_spec = {}
+    _, doc = RoleMixin()._build_doc('example', '/roles/example', '', {'main': empty_spec})
+    assert doc['entry_points']['main'] is empty_spec
+
+
+def test_create_role_doc_omits_roles_without_matching_entry_point(monkeypatch):
+    mixin = RoleMixin()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mixin, '_find_all_normal_roles', lambda *args, **kwargs: {('plain', '/roles/plain')})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mixin, '_find_all_collection_roles', lambda *args, **kwargs: {('collected', 'namespace.collection', '/collections')})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mixin, '_load_argspec', lambda role, **kwargs: {'main': {'options': {}}} if role == 'plain' else {'other': {'options': {}}})
+
+    result = mixin._create_role_doc(('plain', 'collected'), ('/roles',), entry_point='other')
+
+    assert result == {'namespace.collection.collected': {
+        'path': '/collections',
+        'collection': 'namespace.collection',
+        'entry_points': {'other': {'options': {}}},
+    }}
